Pham Khue Anh is a director, with specialties to be rather unique - on *social science*, *philosophy* and **literature**, and research direction specifically tailored for psychology and anthropomorphism. Currently, she is in the process and request of preparing and forming `RHINELAB@PHILR`, the wing of RHINELAB on operations of Philosophy and Literature Research Group, as well as social science under its sub-utilities. She is affiliated on enrolment in Vietnam National University, University of Social Science and Humanities (USSH, Vietnam).
